The artifact clearly states the customer surface (Web UI) will display ISO-8601 UTC dates, with localisation handled by the frontend.
The artifact names Priya as consulted but does not mention Sam being consulted on the date-field decision.
The artifact includes multiple updated versions of the Audit-log PRD (doc.audit_prd) reflecting the resolved date-format decision.
Robin explicitly acknowledges the ETL failures since Friday's hotfix.
Robin mentions 'our engineering team' but does not name a specific person who will investigate.
